notes.title: Drop Command Announce Trailer
notes.notes:
The [b]first official gameplay trailer[/b] for [b]Drop Command[/b] has arrived, giving you a front-row seat to intense tactical mech combat. If you’ve ever dreamed of commanding a lance of war machines, coordinating precision strikes, and leading large-scale planetary campaigns, this is your battlefield.

[b]Watch the gameplay trailer now![/b]
[previewyoutube=UrBho1gxla8;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve been hard at work refining mechanics, expanding content, and ensuring every engagement feels like a proper battlefield command experience. Positioning, firepower, and tactical foresight make all the difference between victory and defeat.

[h3]Drop Command: Tactical Warfare at Its Finest[/h3]

Built for those who love the challenge of commanding heavy war machines in battle, [b]Drop Command[/b] blends mech piloting, squad tactics, and high-level strategic decision-making in a procedurally generated campaign spanning an entire star cluster.

[list]
[*] [b]Lead from the Front:[/b] Command squads of mechs, battle-armored infantry, and VTOLs in real-time tactical combat, where terrain, positioning, and combined-arms tactics determine survival.
[*] [b]Fight Across the Stars:[/b] Deploy across scalding deserts, lush tropical archipelagos, frozen wastelands, and other hostile alien landscapes, each requiring different tactical approaches.
[*] [b]Customize & Adapt:[/b] Outfit your command unit with modular loadouts, balancing mobility, heat management, armor, and firepower to match the mission at hand.
[*] [b]Rise to Command:[/b] Start as a lone warrior and ascend to battlefield commander, directing entire operations while still keeping your metal feet on the ground.
[/list]

Every battle is a test of your tactical skill and piloting prowess. Can you outmaneuver the enemy, manage resources wisely, and command your units to victory?

Your support has been incredible, and [b]wishlisting helps us tremendously![/b] If you’re ready to take command, [b]wishlist and follow[/b] the game on Steam today.

notes.title: Updated Release Date
notes.notes:
[b][u]August Update[/u][/b]

Greetings Mech Pilots, time for another [b]Drop Command[/b] progress update!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778735/f95b232b73d7979ca2b4549d5d7857d536faa37c.gif[/img]

[u][b]Audio[/b][/u]

Our biggest focus since the last update has been adding [b]game audio[/b]. This includes a new soundtrack, weapon and combat SFX, and a combat computer voice. [b][i]All Systems: Operational.[/i][/b]

[u][b]New Biomes[/b][/u]

Introducing three new biomes to spice up combat across the star cluster: 
[list]
[*] [b]Volcanic/Ashlands[/b]: a desolate wasteland with high heat and poor visibility from volcanic ashfall
[*] [b]Archipelago[/b]: an island paradise peaking above the waves of a water world
[*] [b]Megafauna Graveyard[/b]: ancient corpses of spaceborn megafauna litter the planets of the Hyades Cluster
[/list]

As part of the Archipelago biome, we have added water to [b]Drop Command[/b]. Units in water will have a much reduced movement speed, making them easy targets when caught out crossing a river. However, Mechs can sink heat much faster while submerged, so that entering water is a double edged sword.

[u][b]Updated Launch Date[/b][/u]

We are excited to announce we are close to release for Drop Command! We previously had a placeholder date of January 1st. Development has progressed to the point where we are close to the final stages, and we can confidently state our release plans. Keep your eyes to the sky, for Dropships inbound! [b]We are updating the launch date to November 2025.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778735/b025db298180a42ad37e23ff262df9688d86d232.gif[/img]

We are hard at work getting [b]Drop Command[/b] ready, and I cannot wait to share more with you as we make more progress. For more updates, check out our YouTube channel, where we post devlogs and progress updates: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@pillbuggames]@PillBugGames[/url]

notes.title: From the Lightest Scout Mech to the Heaviest Assault Mech
notes.notes:
[b][u]June Update[/u][/b]

Greetings Mech Pilots, time for a [b]Drop Command[/b] progress update!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778735/4dcf76be0fd4f7021f48c99e07d0e90777fc17d4.gif[/img]

Our biggest focus since the last update has been adding [b]game content[/b], with a lot of time also spent polishing [b]game feel[/b]. 

New content includes: new [b]weapons[/b] such as the Anti Missile Systems and Auto-Laser Turret, new pilotable [b]units[/b] such as the Zorilla Light Mech and the Mantis Assault mech, and new planets and [b]biomes[/b].

We have also been adding functionality to the [b]tactical map[/b]. The tactical map will allow for calling down reinforcements where you need them, for issuing general battlefield orders, and to request orbital bombardments. 

For game feel, we've been sanding the rough edges of piloting giant war machines. We have implemented more responsive controls, juicier movement, and a free-look mode so you can look around your cockpit. As well, we have added visual effects polish, improved battlefield debris, cockpit UI polish, and plenty more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778735/539d0e65383133065a434b4d025a5c8d8c7654a5.gif[/img]

The [b]Zorilla Light Mech[/b] is the smallest, fastest flanker this side of the Hyades Star Cluster. It has a primary load-out of 4 Anti-Infantry Flamers, and a heavy duty Mech sized Gatling Gun. Ideal for scouting the battlefield, hunting infantry, and harassing the slower heavier units.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778735/c1a2dec1d57dd7d3faa6871371aabf4e7d1ed4b1.gif[/img]

The [b]Mantis Assault Mech[/b] on the other hand, is a towering behemoth of a Mech. A bastion of raw firepower with more armour plating than a dropship gangway. The primary load-out of this monster includes 2 Auto-Laser Turrets, 36 Unguided Missile Launchers, and 4 Light Plasma Cannons. The Mantis can hold its own against a small army. Or two.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778735/91ce191e95ccd1b20af82192799915b3ccb86a9d.gif[/img]

There is still a ways to go before the demo is ready to launch, but every day we are getting closer! I hope you are as excited as I am for the future of [b]Drop Command[/b], and I cannot wait to share more with you in the coming months.

notes.title: Procedural Bases Coming To A Mech Game Near You
notes.notes:
[b][u]April Update[/u][/b]

Greetings Mech Pilots!

We're hard at work getting [b]Drop Command[/b] closer to a demo release later this year. I'm here to update you on some of our progress! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778735/9cc61764a2b05bc3268b954e77cd0c166f08b833.gif[/img]

Two core mission types in [b]Drop Command[/b] will be the [b]Raid - Defence[/b] and [b]Raid - Attack[/b] scenarios. In these you will be tasked with either defending or destroying an important base with key [b]logistical resources[/b]. The outcome of the mission will impact the future of your campaign. Did you destroy a prominent airfield? The OpFor may face significant trouble fielding VTOL units against you. Did you take out an important munitions depot? Planetary defence forces may find themselves with limited or non-existent missile reserves in the coming clashes.

To facilitate these mission types, we have been working on adding procedural base generation. Our goal is for each base to feel unique, but to also keep a sense of being built for purpose. Buildings are hand crafted, and then used to generate individual base tiles. Tiles are then combined using rule-sets to generate full base layouts in a self-consistent and organized manner.

For a bit of behind-the-scenes, listen to artist Benjamin Parker discuss the making of low poly base assets over here on YouTube:
